#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    istream& reader;
    stringstream tokenizer;
    string currentLine;

    InputReader(istream& stream) : reader(stream) {
    }

    string next() {
        while (tokenizer.eof() || tokenizer.peek() == EOF) {
            if (!getline(reader, currentLine)) {
                throw runtime_error("No more input");
            }
            tokenizer.clear();
            tokenizer.str(currentLine);
        }
        string token;
        tokenizer >> token;
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

class IntStack {
public:
    vector<int> array;
    int size = 0;

    IntStack() : array(8), size(0) {}

    IntStack(int capacity) : array(capacity), size(0) {}

    void push(int item) {
        if (size >= (int)array.size()) {
            array.resize(array.size() * 2);
        }
        array[size++] = item;
    }

    int size() const {
        return size;
    }

    int get(int i) const {
        if (i >= size) {
            throw runtime_error("Index out of bounds");
        }
        return array[i];
    }

    void resize() {
        vector<int> newArray(array.size() * 2);
        copy(array.begin(), array.begin() + size, newArray.begin());
        array = newArray;
    }
};

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    protected:
        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;

    public:
        Modulus() {
            factorial.push(1);
            invFactorial.push(1);
        }

        virtual long long modulus() = 0;

        long long fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.size() <= n) {
                int newSize = factorial.size();
                long long newVal = mult(factorial.get(factorial.size() - 1), newSize);
                factorial.push((int)newVal);
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.size() - 1;

            if (lastKnown < n) {
                vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInv.size(); i++) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.push((int)fInv[i]);
                }
            }

            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            if (n < 0) throw runtime_error("n must be non-negative");
            if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long long smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
        }

        long long normalize(long long x) {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0) x += modulus();
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) {
            long long v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }

        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
            long long v = a - b;
            return v < 0 ? v + modulus() : v;
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
            return mult(mult(a, b), c);
        }

        long long inv(long long value) {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q = g / r;
                g %= r;

                long long temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                x -= q * y;

                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }

            if (g != 1) {
                throw runtime_error("Modular inverse does not exist");
            }

            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };
};

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    int n;
    int m;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, ostream& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();

        mod.fInv(n + m);

        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
            p = mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long numPhases = mod.mult(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
            long long term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
            if ((k & 1) == 1)
                answer = mod.add(answer, term);
            else
                answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
        }

        out << answer << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(cin);
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, cout);
    return 0;
}
